storyline.real: Piquet runs non-stop; Mansell pits for fresh tyres on lap 35, catches him and passes on lap 63 to win by 1.9 seconds
storyline.headline: Piquet holds off the charging Mansell at Silverstone

mastery.label: Beat Mansell at his own game: win with one tyre stop

hidden.label: Win by more than Mansell's real 1.9 seconds

eras.briefing: Silverstone, July 1987. Piquet started on pole, Mansell beside him; both Williams-Hondas were meant to run without a tyre change. Fuel is limited to 195 litres. Pit boards only, no radio. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt from the results and race reports.
